name: Clarent
description: (Tag:enhancer)(Tag:weapon)Clarent, Mordred's Brilliantly Shining Royal Sword that slew Artoria Pendragon, amplifies physical abilities, energy output, and charisma while the wielder rightfully holds the title of King. Killing a Monarch with it transforms it into Clarent Blood, lifting restrictions for free use; otherwise it is only a very durable blunt blade.
